Notes for Toronto, Ontario, Canada, Monday 12 October 2026:

- Environment Canada (forecast issued 11:00 AM EDT, 12 Oct 2026) calls for mainly cloudy weather today with a high of 23°C. Wind is southwest at 20 km/h, gusting to 40. The same forecast has a few showers tonight, with a low of 16°C. The observation at Pearson airport at 12:37 PM was cloudy and 18.6°C, with no rain reported.
- The Weather Network hourly page lists a 20% chance of precipitation for each hour from noon through 10 PM, and 30% at 11 PM. It describes a mix of sun and cloud through the afternoon and partly cloudy skies in the evening. The page's age label is "37 days ago", so it may not be the current version, although the hours listed are for Mon Oct 12.
- AccuWeather shows a blend of sun and clouds today, with a high of 71°F. Tonight is partly cloudy with a couple of showers late, low 62°F. Hourly rain chances from 3 PM to 8 PM are 1–7%. Its page is labelled 16 days old.
- Meteored (theweather.com) lists light rain for today at 90%, but only about 0.008 in, with partly cloudy skies. Its page is labelled 95 days old, so it may be out of date.
- timeanddate lists sprinkles late today, a 21% chance and 0.00" of precipitation. It is labelled 95 days old.
- Weather Underground shows Mostly Cloudy for Mon 10/12, with no rain amount listed. It is labelled 19 days old.
- In short, the sources agree that rain is unlikely during the day today. Showers are expected late tonight, from the evening into overnight.
- Tomorrow (Tue 13 Oct), Environment Canada has showers with a high of 24°C and a 60% chance of showers overnight.
